checks.text: An order that is only on its way is not counted (72 before, 72 after)
Once the buyer has it, the commission is counted: 72 became 96 (2% of 1,200)

shots.caption: Commission with the order on its way: 72

did: Read the month's commission, then a buyer ordered a phone case and the seller accepted and sent it, and the commission was read again. Then the buyer pressed "Yes, I got it" and it was read a third time.
